svg.title: Progress: 72 % of the functions work through the MCP
svg.desc: One square per function. 244 of 337 Solid Edge functions in the coverage map work through the MCP, 86 fail in Solid Edge 2026 and 7 are not tested yet. By area: Application, documents and data 47 of 65; Sketches and reference planes 23 of 27; Part (ordered modeling) 46 of 64; Synchronous modeling and surfaces 20 of 29; Sheet metal 15 of 27; Assemblies 28 of 47; Drawings 43 of 52; Program configuration 22 of 26.
